description: Cross-artifact lifecycle lens. When an IN-SCOPE contract deploys/initializes/owns/upgrades/configures/holds-custody-over an artifact (often an OUT-OF-SCOPE token/collection/escrow/vault/proxy), that artifact's lifecycle invariants stay audit-relevant THROUGH the in-scope controller. Recovers the ArkProject AK-H4 miss: Deployer/CollectionManager deploy an upgradeable ERC721 proxy but never transfer ownership / never _disableInitializers. Advisory recall lens — never blocks.
review_hint: An in-scope contract controls an artifact's lifecycle. Verify: is the artifact ownership transferred to the controller (or a trusted admin)? Is the initializer disabled (or protected)? Can the controller still upgrade/configure/recover the artifact post-deploy? Can users permanently lose assets via a recipient/lifecycle mismatch? The artifact's lifecycle is in-scope THROUGH the controller even if the artifact file is out of scope.
